events.name: TechFest 2026 : Networking Workshop
events.description: TechFest 2026: Networking Workshop is a half-day academic seminar designed to help IT students build professional connections with industry practitioners, alumni, and fellow students. The event aims to (1) introduce students to current trends and career pathways in the IT industry, (2) develop practical networking skills such as self-introduction, professional communication, and LinkedIn profile building, and (3) provide opportunities for mentorship and future internship or collaboration leads. Activities include a keynote talk from an industry speaker, a guided networking workshop with icebreakers and role-play exercises, a panel discussion with professionals, and an open networking session.
events.requisites: Valid student ID, formal or business casual attire, printed or digital copy of resume/CV (optional), laptop or smartphone for profile-building activities, signed parental/guardian waiver
